5'10 M 35 y/o I went from 225-175lbs in about 6 months. Here's what worked for me. Take from this what you will but it took me a while to really find my stride and this seemed to work:

Diet:

* ~1500 cals per day carefully tracked in myfitnesspal

* Usually one cheat meal one weekend day, regret the next three days or so

* A beer or drink here and there but rarely more then 2 in one sitting. It messes up my progress so I try to abstain.

Macros:

* 40% Protein

* 40% Carbs

* 20% Fat

Workout:

* First thing in the morning on an empty stomach. Push/ Pull/ Legs,Abs Split

* I got a fitness tracker with HR monitoring early on and found that I burn significantly more calories weight lifting after cardio than weight lifting with no cardio or doing cardio afterwards which takes hella will power.

* Cardio before weight training Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. I like to do the treadmill Monday and Friday and add in a spin bike, elliptical, or row machine on Wednesday. To much running is hard on my hips cause I'm old and shit. I like to do HIIT on the treadmill every few weeks to increase my pace then try to stick with that pace for a few weeks.

Supplements:

* BCAA, pre-work out prior to exercise

* Whey Protein shake right after with breakfast (Hand full of ice cubes, one scoop of choc or vanilla whey, one banana, 1/2 cup non fat milk, 1/2 cup coffee, 1/2 tsp cinamon. Mix with magic bullet. Drink!)

* Intense hatred of my own physique

I stayed below my calorie intake and ran/jogged with added body weight exercises every single day after work. When my stomach flattened out I started going back to the gym to add lifting back into my routine.

I did all this just by limiting what I ate. I started losing the weight even before I began adding more exercise into it. Just gotta commit to the calorie counting and be mindful. You'll lose the gut the same way I did.

So I got a house back in January of this year. First week in I see a moth but i had yet to move in a fly swatter or my towels. tl;dr I used a lighter to kill a moth and its body is still 100% after all these months.
Killed moth on wall with lighter back in January. Body is still 100% the same. why?
And an additional question: When you squish them, why do they turn into silver glitter? Or some sort of ashy type thing instead of squishing with blood like flies do?

The glitter covers their wings, almost like very tiny feathers, but it's quite fragile so in killing them it's displaced.

Moths like most insects have an exoskeleton with their "meat" inside, so just like a mammal that dies and is left in the environment the meat is consumed but the skeleton remains, however because the skeleton is on the outside, the appearance changes very little.
